children: Blue filed an updated investor presentation disclosing the Blockfusion business combination, including an executed 15-year, 85MW take-or-pay lease with CoreWeave and financial forecasts tied to a pro forma transaction.
Updated investor presentation furnished under Regulation FD for the proposed Business Combination with Blockfusion and Pubco.
Executed 15-year anchor lease with CoreWeave for 85MW take-or-pay critical IT load, projected ~$2.8bn revenue over initial terms.
Presentation assumes Blockfusion pre-money equity value of $450M and contemplates up to $100M of financing transaction capital.
Management forecasts delivery of revenues beginning 2028 with capex plan ~ $920M (2026–2029) to support HPC/AI transition and 85MW buildout.
Registration Statement on Form S-4 filed; shareholders will receive Proxy Statement/Prospectus with voting details and risks highlighted.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Blue files updated investor presentation for Blockfusion combination, shows 85MW CoreWeave lease
